import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def maxVal : BinarySearchTree → Int
| BinarySearchTree.Empty => 0
| BinarySearchTree.Node v _ BinarySearchTree.Empty => v
| BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => maxVal r

def deleteMax : BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
| BinarySearchTree.Empty => BinarySearchTree.Empty
| BinarySearchTree.Node _ l BinarySearchTree.Empty => l
| BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => BinarySearchTree.Node v l (deleteMax r)

def deleteAux : BinarySearchTree → Int → BinarySearchTree
| BinarySearchTree.Empty, _ => BinarySearchTree.Empty
| BinarySearchTree.Node x l r, v =>
    if v < x then
      BinarySearchTree.Node x (deleteAux l v) r
    else if x < v then
      BinarySearchTree.Node x l (deleteAux r v)
    else
      match l with
      | BinarySearchTree.Empty => r
      | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ =>
          BinarySearchTree.Node (maxVal l) (deleteMax l) r

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t v) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  deleteAux t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : delete_precond t v) : Prop :=

  view result = view t \ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

theorem mem_view_node_iff {x a : Int} {l r : BinarySearchTree} :
    x ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node a l r) ↔

  simp [view, Set.mem_union]
